field_roles.identity_fingerprint_fields: Hashed with SHA-256 (after normalization) to produce the ledger key. Two events with the same identity fields share a fingerprint regardless of variant_fields.
field_roles.variant_fields: Stored in the ledger entry and compared event-to-event. Unchanged variant_fields on a repeated fingerprint → FORCE_RCA. Changed variant_fields → LOG_NEW_VARIANT.

normalize_rules: strip volatile timestamps matching ISO-8601 patterns
replace absolute temp dirs (/tmp/... or OS equiv) with <TMP>
collapse runs of whitespace to single space
preserve target repo/path and command semantics
recurrence_rule: same identity_fingerprint twice without changed variant_fields forces FORCE_RCA route

decisions.LOG_ONLY: First occurrence; ledger entry written; no RCA required.
decisions.FORCE_RCA: Same normalized fingerprint recurred with unchanged variant_fields (input_digest, evidence_digest); RCA routing required.
decisions.LOG_NEW_VARIANT: Same identity fingerprint but one or more variant_fields changed; treated as a new variant, not a recurrence.

ledger_entry_schema.fingerprint: sha256 hex string of normalized identity_fingerprint_fields
